title: helichrysum spiralepis
intro: Helichrysum spiralepis, commonly known as the yellow mountain daisy, is a flowering plant that belongs to the daisy family (Asteraceae). This plant is valued for its various health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties that can help soothe wounds, reduce pain, and protect against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Helichrysum spiralepis include its ability to promote tissue repair, reduce inflammation, and alleviate symptoms associated with arthritis, sprains, and strains. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
